names: Mono- and diacetyl tartaric acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids
display_name: E472e (Mono- and diacetyl tartaric acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids)

more_info.overview: E472e covers glycerol esters combining mono- and diacetyltartaric acid with fatty acids from edible fats and oils; the preparation is a mixture that may retain small quantities of its starting materials. Its emulsifying role is to help form or maintain mixtures of oil and water in the finished food. A mixture of glycerol esters containing mono- and diacetyltartaric acid and fatty acids from food fats or oils. The specification does not establish a single animal or plant source for the fatty-acid component. The specified material is supplied as yellow liquid or waxy solid.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain cocoa and Chocolate products as covered by Directive 2000/36/EC; other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; chewing gum; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; fruit juices as defined by Directive 2001/112/EC and vegetable juices; flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.origin: A mixture of glycerol esters containing mono- and diacetyltartaric acid and fatty acids from food fats or oils. The specification does not establish a single animal or plant source for the fatty-acid component.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid feedstock is not specified as exclusively plant derived. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability cannot be established without the supplier identifying the raw material and processing.
